categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the steel industry, focusing on manufacturing and selling rebar (reinforcing steel bars) used in construction. It also produces oxygen and gases for industrial use and engages in related metal product manufacturing and sales. The business is concentrated in a single segment centered on steel production and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses electric furnace steelmaking technology with 120-ton electric furnaces and rolling facilities to produce high-quality rebar. It employs digitalization in the electric furnace steelmaking process to enhance operational efficiency and has developed proprietary technologies related to rolling and steel production, supported by multiple patents. The production process includes scrap steel procurement, melting, rolling, and quality certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction companies, distributors, and government procurement agencies, with major clients such as Taeyoung Construction, Daewoo Construction, and Hanwha. The primary market is domestic South Korea, serving the construction industry, which accounts for the majority of demand for rebar products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within South Korea, with production facilities in Changwon and Jeungpyeong. Sales and distribution cover major regions including Busan, Gyeongnam, Gyeongin, Seoul, and other regional offices across the country. Export sales are minimal, with small shipments to Equatorial Guinea and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the steel supply chain, focusing on steel production from scrap metal and supplying finished steel products, primarily rebar, to downstream customers such as construction firms and distributors. It sources raw materials like scrap steel both domestically and through imports.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include cost reduction, securing stable raw material supply, and enhancing product quality through technology development. R&D efforts focus on digitalizing steelmaking processes, developing carbon-neutral core technologies, and improving rolling and automation systems. The company invests in new product development, process improvements, and certification to maintain competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of steel products, especially rebar, to domestic customers. The company also earns income from selling industrial gases produced onsite. Sales are conducted via direct orders and planned production, with payments made in cash, notes, or letters of credit for exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds approximately 9.7% domestic market share in rebar production, competing with other Korean steelmakers and facing competitive pressures from Chinese steel producers and international markets. It is positioned as a mid-sized player with stable credit ratings and focuses on quality and cost competitiveness to maintain its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately 905 billion KRW, a 14.95% decrease from the previous year, with operating profit of 86.6 billion KRW and net income of 68.2 billion KRW. The company has stable financial health with no borrowings, a low debt ratio of 14.17%, and total assets around 972 billion KRW. Despite recent revenue declines due to market conditions, it maintains profitability and a solid capital base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality steel production using advanced electric furnace technology and digitalized processes to deliver reliable rebar products. It focuses on cost efficiency, stable raw material procurement, and customer satisfaction through quality, service, and diversified sales channels. Its environmental management and certifications also support its value proposition in sustainable steel production.
